detailed_description:
The target video is a living sumi ink painting in <Subject 2>: every stroke keeps its wet brushed texture as it moves, ink flows and drips like real liquid ink on paper, and the hairline moon and cloud outlines stay thin, clean and steady.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The black cat sits still on the long brush stroke of ink, gazing up at the moon, then slowly rises and lowers her chest into a hunting crouch facing right, front paws sliding forward and hindquarters lifting. Her long tail rises behind her and streams into a thick ribbon of wet ink that curls upward, shedding small drops. Scattered ink spatter dots drift slowly across the white paper and the hairline clouds curl gently around the moon. The camera pushes in toward her at slow speed in one continuous move, the moon sliding up and out toward the upper right corner as she grows larger in frame. The camera is still pushing in as the shot ends on <Picture 2>, the cat crouched and ready to spring. No cut or transition occurs.
